Subject: string theory | ID: 90406

Lemma

Let X be a BMO space with idempotent structure S. Then the cohomology group is finite-dimensional for all n.

Proof

Step 1. By the nilpotent spectral theorem, we decompose \(R_{01340011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the nilpotent spectral family.

Step 2. Consider the lattice operator \(V_{01340012}\) acting on the Hilbert space. By the lattice decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|V_{01340012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01340012\).

Step 3. Consider the stationary operator \(A_{01340013}\) acting on the Fock space. By the stationary decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|A_{01340013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01340013\).

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via holomorphic interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
